cohort: 70,607 people who filled an opioid prescription within 7 days of hospital discharge after delivery between September 1, 2012, and June 30, 2020
finding: Initiation of oxycodone after delivery was not associated with an increased risk of persistent opioid use compared to codeine, except after vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Oxycodone use was associated with persistent opioid use after vaginal delivery but not after cesarean delivery.
